description: Switch the production platform off at nights and weekends, outside protection windows
risks_and_exceptions: Business hours come from daily data (active hours minus job hours), not hourly measurements; keep a 2 h buffer after office hours. Automatic start before 02:00 and before office hours. Only outside protection windows: R01 last 3 working days of each month, 18:00-04:00; R18 every day, 02:00-08:00; R19 every working day in January, 20:00-02:00
assumptions_and_sources: Off weekends 08:00-02:00 and working days 20:00-02:00; never on closing days or January working days: 3,210 of 8,760 h per year. Node-hours fall in proportion. Checked against every scheduled job run: 1,487 runs, 0 overlap an off window. Interactive use on working days is about 6.1 h (at most 9.1 h), so it fits before 20:00. Sources: data_platform_usage.csv, extra/data_platform_jobs.csv, it_tickets.csv (T-1029); docs/answers/q3_production_platform_off_hours.md. Effort: scheduler with automatic start, test against finance close and nightly jobs, monitoring.

description: Run the development cluster only on working days 08:00-18:00 and during quarterly training
risks_and_exceptions: Training must start automatically on days 1-3 of each quarter (rule R02). Only outside protection windows: R02 days 1-3 of January, April, July and October
assumptions_and_sources: Running 2,728 of 8,760 h: working days 08:00-18:00 plus 24 h on training days. The cluster is idle 91 % today and its jobs may run between 08:00 and 18:00. Sources: data_platform_usage.csv, extra/data_platform_jobs.csv, it_tickets.csv (T-1053). Effort: auto-stop/auto-start policy for the cluster, keep quarterly training.

description: Start the GPU server only when needed: working days 08:00-18:00 and quarterly training
risks_and_exceptions: Training days 1-3 of each quarter stay protected (rule R04). Only outside protection windows: R04 days 1-3 of January, April, July and October
assumptions_and_sources: Running 2,728 of 8,760 h. Average GPU load is 6 % outside the four training weeks (about 43 % in them). Sources: server_metrics_weekly.csv, azure_costs.csv, it_tickets.csv (T-1035, T-1101). Effort: start/stop on demand with a schedule, keep quarterly training.
